text: SN: the slate trigger stands for me: h1_close_above:bar_high after a pull-in to the Creek (structure_shift_ref), timing WAIT. The break came on day_vol 2.72 and W HH/HL, H1 HH/HL hold, but D last_bar red and dist_to_20bar_high_pct 2.55 with pct_from_pivot 5.09: away from the Creek. Dropping the pull-in is chasing (C3, C15); reclaim:ma_20 buys the probe close (C12). Oneil's h1_close_above:pivot_high is the same Creek test in other words; I accept either, the pull-in first. Wrong if a daily close back under pivot_high.
